question: Does the previously observed development-only mixed surface/stylometric signal persist under a finite set of controls for length, lexical/topic overlap, repeated formulaic turns, immediate-partner behavior, speaker frequency and direct profile leakage?
purpose: Determine whether the frozen style vector is defensible only as a secondary exploratory endpoint for a real-speaker generative pilot; this study cannot validate generative Persona Fidelity.

split_policy.access_implementation: Scan only structural bytes through the utterances key for every dialogue; fully parse text only after both interlocutors are assigned DEVELOPMENT.

frozen_controls.name: feature_ablations
frozen_controls.estimand: Mean and distribution of other-median-minus-own standardized L1 margin after removing length features, explicit lexical/morphological laughter and politeness markers, and both groups jointly.

frozen_controls.name: length_matching_and_imbalance
frozen_controls.estimand: Style margin against the ten eligible controls nearest in target turn and character counts; Spearman association of original margins with available dialogue count, selected amount and source-target length imbalance; equal-count frequency tertiles.

frozen_controls.name: topic_lexical_negative_control
frozen_controls.estimand: Within-profile minus other-median content-character trigram Jaccard overlap, plus style margin against the ten controls nearest to the own-profile trigram overlap. Character trigrams are not a semantic topic model.

frozen_controls.name: formulaic_and_direct_leakage
frozen_controls.estimand: Counts of exact normalized turns shared between source and target, style margin after removing such turns from both sides, and structural source-target dialogue and partner-overlap violations.

frozen_controls.name: immediate_partner_negative_control
frozen_controls.estimand: Partner-source-to-target minus own-source-to-target standardized L1 distance using the two source-dialogue partners' turns. Positive values favor the focal source over immediate partner language but cannot exclude broader accommodation.

registered_readout_rules.immediate_partner_negative_control: Mean partner-minus-own distance > 0 and positive-speaker proportion > 0.5.
registered_readout_rules.exact_turn_leakage_flag: At least one exact normalized source-target turn overlap.

uncertainty_policy: Report speaker-level median, interquartile range and positive proportion descriptively. No p-values, confidence intervals or population-confirmatory claims are authorized.
privacy: Emit only aggregate counts, statistics and hashes; no participant text, pseudonymous IDs or row-level values.
claim_boundary: A robust result supports only a development-set mixed surface/stylometric proxy. It cannot establish stable identity independent of topic, generative Persona Fidelity, a conditioning effect, population generalization or independent validation.
